closing one eye quickly; "forty winks" = a short sleep

The lamb's tail moves very quickly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one pass of a needle and thread when sewing
vocabulary.example: A stitch in time saves nine.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the machinery inside a clock; "like clockwork" = very regularly

fine_lines.title: at the eleventh hour vs around the clock
fine_lines.explanation_ar: at the eleventh hour تعني في آخر لحظة. around the clock تعني ليلًا ونهارًا دون توقّف.
fine_lines.explanation_en: At the eleventh hour = at the last possible moment. Around the clock = all day and all night, without stopping.

examples.sentence: He handed in his project at the eleventh hour.
Nurses work around the clock in the hospital.

fine_lines.title: take five vs forty winks
fine_lines.explanation_ar: take five استراحة قصيرة (نحو خمس دقائق). forty winks نوم قصير أو قيلولة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Take five = a short break (about five minutes). Forty winks = a short sleep, a nap.

examples.sentence: We've worked for two hours. Let's take five.
I'm tired; I need forty winks.

expressions.phrase: a stitch in time saves nine
expressions.meaning_ar: درهم وقاية خير من قنطار علاج
expressions.meaning_en: fixing a small problem early saves a lot of work later (9)
expressions.example: Fix that small leak now; a stitch in time saves nine.
Every morning at seven, like clockwork, he goes for a walk.

The shop is open around the clock.
